description: The file contains the implementation of the CalendarSync class, which acts as a facade for calendar synchronization functionalities within the SuiteCRM system. It manages various aspects such as syncing calendar accounts and meetings, testing provider connections, handling configurations, and integrating with external calendar providers. It also includes methods for managing synchronization operations and resolving potential duplicate accounts.

classes.name: CalendarSync
classes.description: Main facade class providing calendar synchronization operations, configuration management, provider testing, and account handling functionalities within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: syncAllCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Triggers synchronization for all calendar accounts, optionally as a manual run, handling logging and configuration updates.

methods.name: syncAllMeetingsOfCalendarAccount
methods.description: Synchronizes all meetings under a specified calendar account, validating the account before proceeding.

methods.name: syncMeeting
methods.description: Handles synchronization of individual meeting objects based on their state and attributes.

methods.name: getActiveCalendarAccountForUser
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent validated personal calendar account for a specific user.

methods.name: getActiveCalendarAccountsForUser
methods.description: Returns all validated calendar accounts associated with a user.

methods.name: hasPersonalCalendarAccount
methods.description: Checks if the specified user has a personal calendar account.

methods.name: getPersonalCalendarAccounts
methods.description: Retrieves personal calendar accounts associated with a user.

methods.name: syncEvent
methods.description: Deserializes event data and orchestrates synchronization, returning success status.

methods.name: getProviderAuthMethodWithValidation
methods.description: Gets the authentication method for a provider source, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: testProviderConnectionWithValidation
methods.description: Tests the connection to a calendar provider for a given account, with validation.

methods.name: findDuplicateCalendarAccount
methods.description: Checks if an external calendar ID is already associated with another account, excluding the current one.

methods.name: getFieldsToHide
methods.description: Returns an array of fields to hide based on the provider's authentication method.

methods.name: getCalendarSourceTypes
methods.description: Provides available calendar source types from registered providers.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves configuration data provided via form POST.

methods.name: getScheduler
methods.description: Returns the scheduler instance for scheduling jobs.
